sobre_bio.p1: I'm a full-stack developer based in Campo Grande, Brazil, working with React, TypeScript, NestJS and MongoDB to build production systems, currently focused on logistics and fleet management software.
sobre_bio.p2: Before coding full-time, I spent over 14 years as co-founder and CTO of a regional internet service provider (ISP), where I built and operated the entire network infrastructure from scratch: BGP/OSPF routing, GPON/FTTH deployment, peering at the local internet exchange, and monitoring with Zabbix and Grafana. I sold the company in 2024 and moved fully into software development, bringing that systems-level view and infrastructure mindset with me.

hero_sub: From front-end to database, from admin panel to on-chain contract. Fifteen years of infrastructure make sure what I ship stays up.
